customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to operate with quick face unlocking, and appreciate its premium build quality and top-tier security features. They like its appearance, noting it looks like a simple door handle, and one customer mentions the mocha finish matches perfectly with their main door. The lock functions well, with one customer noting it works even in low light conditions, and customers find the features useful for the whole family. The value for money receives mixed reviews.

reviews.author: Tamal Ghosh
reviews.title: Not flawless
reviews.body: This product is good but it has a major design flaw. None of my guests able to open the door when they leave the home. I always have to open the door if the visitor is new. Opening door from the inside is non intuitive, hidden behind the handle and very confusing. Nobody still today able to open the door in the first time without asking us to open the door for them. I think I have been using it for 3 months now and still finding a smart one who can open the door in first trial. May be I sound like too dramatic and making it a big deal on small issue. reviews.title: Very happy with the purchase
reviews.body: Best in the lock category.. really happy with the security of the lock and after sale service by Urban Clap. Go ahead and buy… its one time investment ✨

reviews.author: Prashant Sharma
reviews.title: Really 3rd class app and user experience.
reviews.body: The lock itself is ok. However, beware, the app they use is really 3rd class. Its slow, laggy, takes forever to connect to the lock. The app has a very poor interface also. You will need to press 3 buttons to reach the lock! And if you try and turn off sound notification, the pop ups also get auto blocked. I am on samsung fold 6. Still havent managed to figure out how to get this app to show me pop ups without sound! And there is a considerable lag in the app notification on mobile from the time someone rings the bell! reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: Great Look and Excellent Features
reviews.body: Very happy with my purchase! The mocha finish matches perfectly with our main door, and the lock has some great features that make it convenient and easy to use. Overall, very satisfied with the product.
